Name: Custom NPC - Kim Jyeul
Author: ExnoticTest
Description:
[b](PLANNED, v4.0.0?) 1.6 support and maybe events

This may be on hold as I wish to release Taka Kuromiya NPC and expansion Shadowborn Soultales, both currently WIP and must also be converted to 1.6.
[/b]
Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/41011220]It﻿sBenter[/url] for portraits and sprites!

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]Lemurkat[/url]﻿ for designing her Boarding House room!
Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/123544313?tab=about+me]Obamoose[/url] for converting things from TMXL to CP and helping merge the folders.

Her spawn point is at the Bus Stop (or her Boarding House room).
Has dialogue about Jade, Toshinori, Shouko, Shiko, Delores, Juliet and Mike if you have them.
[u]
[b]Overview:[/b][/u]
Kim Jyeul, a Gotoro Empire resident, loves to visit Pelican Town (for many reasons).
She's really shy.
Will you sway her heart and help her overcome her shyness?

[b][u]Overview (Boarding House): [/u][/b]
Kim Jyeul, a former Gotoro Empire resident, moved to Pelican Town (for many reasons).
She's really shy.
Will you sway her heart and help her overcome her shyness?

[u][b]Gifts:[/b][/u]
[spoiler]Love: Cherry Cobbler (Included with this mod), Sweet Vermillion Wine (Included with this mod), Diamond, Blueberry Tart, Daffodil
Like: Blackberry Cobbler, Blue Jazz, Aquamarine, Fairy Rose, Sashimi
Neutral: Joja Cola
Dislike: Dandelion, Poppy, Tulip, Pumpkin Pie
Hate: Survival Burger, Any Mushroom[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description:
[CP] Edited Kim's Shop for map edit compatibility and added a config to disable it as well.
[CP] Fixed wedding dialogue issue.
[MFM] Merged both files together.
The Boarding House Room is now a part of the main download.
